subject: Vendr account delegation choreography & CAIQ proof-of-possession
messages:
From: Ellis Chapman <ellis@brightleaf.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr access + CAIQ proof-of-possession (Brightleaf)

Hi Rohan —

We need to onboard Redwood into Brightleaf's Vendr profile so our procurement/security team can validate the CAIQ and limited SOC2 artifacts for the upcoming renewal. Two asks from our side: 1) a delegated uploader account that can drop evidence into our staged bucket (we prefer temporary, role-based access), and 2) a short proof-of-possession for the SSO configuration (sample SAML response or a screenshot of the Assertion consumer URL and issuer).

Can Redwood create a delegated role with an email like vendor-uploader@redwood.com and share the invitation flow (we use Vendr). Also, can you map the CAIQ questions to the evidence filenames you plan to upload — a simple CSV is perfect.

Timeline: risk team wants a working upload channel by next Wednesday (2027-04-07). If we need a quick checkpoint, happy to jump on a 20m call.

Thanks —
Ellis
Security Operations
Brightleaf

Attachments: none

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Ellis Chapman <ellis@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr access + CAIQ proof-of-possession (Brightleaf)

Hi Ellis —

Thanks for the clear asks. We can absolutely do this and hit the Wednesday target. High-level plan: 

- Create a scoped service account (vendor-uploader@redwood.com) with time-limited SSO binding and a role limited to the staged bucket + evidence upload route in Vendr.
- Provide a CAIQ -> evidence filename mapping CSV. We'll include question IDs and the exact file paths in S3 (or Vendr metadata).
- For SSO proof-of-possession: we'll provide a short SAML metadata snippet and a screenshot of the assertion configuration (no sensitive tokens).

I'll kick this off and loop Priya and Kimberly; Priya will be the uploader owner and will share the CSV + docs. Kimberly will coordinate the invitation inside Vendr and confirm the invite flow (screenshots).

Next steps: Priya will upload the mapping CSV and a draft delegation checklist (see attachment). Kimberly will send the actual invite and screenshot once it's created. If you want a quick sync, I'm free Tues 10–11am PT.

Rohan
VP, Technical Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendr-delegation-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr access + CAIQ proof-of-possession (Brightleaf)

Ellis / team —

Attached is the CAIQ export mapping we discussed (caiq-export-2027-04-04.csv). Columns: CAIQ_ID, Short Question, Intended Evidence Filename, S3 Path, Notes. A few implementation notes: 

- We will upload SOC2 artefacts (system_description.pdf, control-evidence/*.pdf) under s3://redwood-evidence/brightleaf/2027/renewal/. The CSV lists what we plan to attach to each CAIQ ID.
- The vendor-uploader identity will be a service principal bound to our IdP and scoped via Vendr ACLs to only the "staging uploads" route. We will not expose long-lived keys; uploads will use short-lived presigned URLs issued server-side.
- DocuSign: we need a signed release for SOC2 artifact sharing; I've created a DocuSign envelope and pasted the submission link below. If you can sign by EOD Wed we can start the upload process on Thu.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/links/abcd-efgh-2027

I'm attaching the CSV and a short checklist (vendr-delegation-checklist.pdf) that outlines the roles/permissions we need from your side when you accept the invitation.

Happy to answer mapping questions.

—Priya
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: caiq-export-2027-04-04.csv, vendr-delegation-checklist.pdf, docusign-soc2-release-link.txt

From: Ellis Chapman <ellis@brightleaf.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 07:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr access + CAIQ proof-of-possession (Brightleaf)

Thanks Priya — that CSV looks good to our auditors. A couple quick items: 

- We signed the DocuSign envelope this morning.
- Can you confirm the retention window for uploaded evidence (Brightleaf policy expects 12 months of staged artifacts unless otherwise noted)? Also, will uploads include a manifest file that lists object hashes?
- If you can, please create the vendor-uploader invitation in Vendr and we'll accept; we also want a screenshot of the invite and the SSO binding screen for our audit notes.

We can accept the invitation now; please send the invite link. If everything's good we'll have the initial proof and manifest by EOD.

Ellis

Subject: Re: Vendr access + CAIQ proof-of-possession (Brightleaf)

Ellis —

Invite sent. Username: vendor-uploader@redwood.com (service principal). The Vendr invitation flow requires the recipient org to accept; once accepted the account is scoped to the "Staging: evidence-upload" role. Screenshot attached (vendr-invite-screenshot.png).

Retention & manifest details: 
- Retention: default staged retention set to 12 months. We record an object-level created_at and a lifecycle tag so you can apply longer holds if needed.
- Manifest: we'll upload s3-manifest.csv alongside the evidence bundle. Each row contains filename, size_bytes, sha256_hex, uploaded_by, uploaded_at. Example manifest is attached.

We'll start pushing the first batch after you confirm acceptance. If you want us to strip any PII from logs or snapshots we can apply an extra redaction pass before upload — let us know.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Product Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendr-invite-screenshot.png, s3-manifest.csv
